import collections,hashlib,json,os,stat,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'tools'))
from steam_content import file_plan,profile,manifest_path
from mcc_content import directory,MccCache
from mcc_loading_presentation import read_media,MEDIA_SHA
owned=Path.home()/'Library/Application Support/net.halo2forever/downloads/steam-mcc/e46c404c25077cdd5c064c12'
out=root/'build/test-results/macos-steam-download/source-audit.json'
report={'schema':'H2_MACOS_STEAM_SOURCE_AUDIT_V1','scratch':os.environ['HALO2_TEST_SCRATCH'],'source_owner':str(owned),'read_only_source_audit':True,'preparation_started':False,'retained_generated_artifacts':[]}
started=time.monotonic()
try:
 complete=json.loads((owned/'complete.json').read_text())
 raw=(owned/'selected-files.json').read_bytes();files=json.loads(raw)
 assert complete['schema']=='H2_STEAM_COMPLETE_V1' and complete['source_id']==owned.name
 assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==complete['inventory_sha256']
 marker=json.loads((owned/'owner.json').read_text());rules=profile()
 depots={'depots':[dict(depot_id=d['depot_id'],manifest_id=d['manifest_id'],role=rules['depots'][str(d['depot_id'])]) for d in marker['depots']]}
 manifests=[dict(depot_id=d['depot_id'],manifest_id=d['manifest_id'],files=[dict(name=f['path'],bytes=f['bytes'],compressed_bytes=f['download_bytes'],sha1=f['sha1']) for f in files if f['depot_id']==d['depot_id']]) for d in marker['depots']]
 planned=file_plan(depots,manifests)
 assert (len(planned['files']),planned['bytes'],planned['download_bytes'])==(883,42179329726,28103673648)
 verified_bytes=0;required=[]
 for f in planned['files']:
  path=owned/'content'/manifest_path(f['path'])
  p=path
  while p!=owned.parent:
   assert not p.is_symlink(),'Linked source entry'
   p=p.parent
  before=path.stat()
  assert stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_size==f['bytes']
  with path.open('rb') as stream:digest=hashlib.file_digest(stream,'sha1').hexdigest()
  after=path.stat()
  assert (before.st_size,before.st_mtime_ns,before.st_ino)==(after.st_size,after.st_mtime_ns,after.st_ino)
  assert digest==f['sha1'],'Source checksum mismatch'
  verified_bytes+=before.st_size
  if f['path'].casefold() in {p.casefold() for p in rules['required_files']}:required.append(f)
 source=directory(owned/'content/halo2');assert source==owned/'content/halo2'
 assert directory(source.parent)==source and directory(source/'h2_maps_win64_dx11')==source
 cache=MccCache(source/'h2_maps_win64_dx11/lockout.map')
 report['lockout_reader']={'tags':len(cache.tags),'groups':dict(collections.Counter(v['group'] for v in cache.tags.values()))}
 assert report['lockout_reader']['tags']>0
 cache.close()
 media,provenance=read_media(source);assert hashlib.sha256(media).hexdigest()==MEDIA_SHA
 report.update(passed=True,files_verified=len(planned['files']),bytes_verified=verified_bytes,
  inventory_sha256=complete['inventory_sha256'],independent_plan_sha256=planned['plan_sha256'],
  required_files=required,all_selected_files_sha1_verified_independently=True,
  production_source_directory_admitted=True,loading_media={'bytes':len(media),'sha256':MEDIA_SHA},
  source=str(source),receipt=complete)
 report['storage']={'files':0,'logical_bytes':0,'allocated_bytes':0}
 for p in owned.rglob('*'):
  if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink():
   s=p.stat();report['storage']['files']+=1;report['storage']['logical_bytes']+=s.st_size;report['storage']['allocated_bytes']+=s.st_blocks*512
 report['source_sha256']={name:hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ['tools/steam_content.py','tools/steam/content-profile.json','tools/mcc_content.py','tools/mcc_loading_presentation.py']}
except BaseException as e:report.update(passed=False,error=type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)[:1000])
finally:
 report['elapsed_seconds']=round(time.monotonic()-started,3)
 out.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'passed':report.get('passed'),'files':report.get('files_verified'),'bytes':report.get('bytes_verified'),'error':report.get('error'),'elapsed_seconds':report['elapsed_seconds']}),flush=True)
sys.exit(0 if report.get('passed') else 1)

import json,os,plistlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'build/test-results/macos-steam-download'
active=json.loads((out/'active-owner.json').read_text());receipt=json.loads((out/'report.json').read_text())
paths=[Path(active['scratch']),Path(active['build']).parent]
paths += [Path(v['path']) for v in active['released_inputs']]
removed=[{'path':str(p),'removed':not p.exists()} for p in paths]
raw=subprocess.check_output(['ps','-ax','-o','pid=','-o','ppid=','-o','args='],text=True)
processes=[]
for line in raw.splitlines():
 parts=line.strip().split(None,2)
 if len(parts)==3:
  try:processes.append((int(parts[0]),int(parts[1]),parts[2]))
  except ValueError:pass
parents={pid:parent for pid,parent,args in processes};excluded=set();current=os.getpid()
while current and current not in excluded:excluded.add(current);current=parents.get(current,0)
live=[{'pid':pid,'parent_pid':parent} for pid,parent,args in processes if pid not in excluded and any(str(p) in args for p in paths[:2])]
images=plistlib.loads(subprocess.check_output(['hdiutil','info','-plist']))['images']
mounts=[{'image_path':image.get('image-path')} for image in images if any(str(p) in str(image.get('image-path','')) for p in paths[:2])]
result={'schema':'H2_MACOS_STEAM_DOWNLOAD_CLEANUP_V1','owned_paths':removed,'live_owned_processes':live,'owned_disk_images':mounts,'cmake_passed':receipt['passed'],'retained_generated_artifacts':[],
'retained_reference_inputs':[{'path':str(Path.home()/'Library/Application Support/net.halo2forever/downloads/steam-mcc/e46c404c25077cdd5c064c12'),'kind':'User-authorized owned MCC source; preserve for port testing','allocated_file_bytes':42185318400}],
'passed':all(v['removed'] for v in removed) and not live and not mounts}
(out/'cleanup.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result))
